name: Play from the editor finds liblantern-native on macOS
body:
Dean (2026-11-06): the editor runs through `mist run editor` on his Mac, but pressing Play fails with "dyld: Library not loaded: @rpath/liblantern-native.dylib, Referenced from: engine/build/lantern, Reason: no LC_RPATH's found".

Cause: Play doesn't build the game. It runs whatever `engine/build/lantern` is already there, and Dean's was linked before liblantern-native took its build directory as its macOS install name (0107b78, 2026-11-05). That older library's install name was `@rpath/liblantern-native.dylib`, and nox links no rpath, so the stale binary can't find the library. Nothing sets DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH for it either: `mist run` and `nox run` both start programs through /bin/sh, and macOS drops DYLD_* variables for it. A `lantern` built now records liblantern-native's full path in Mist's build tree, so it loads with no rpath or environment.

Fix: `mist run editor` builds the game (`nox build --release --project engine`) before starting the editor, so Play always runs a `lantern` linked against the current liblantern-native. nox's build stamp makes this a no-op when the game is up to date.

comments.text: Confirmed on Dean's Mac (2026-11-06): Play from mist run editor opens the course and plays it. Fixed in #57.
